d:
When a wild animal needs help, Turtleman is ready to answer the call. Ernie Brown Jr., along with Neal James and Team Turtle, takes on unexpected animal encounters and challenging rescue missions. From catching wild creatures to getting them out of trouble, every mission brings something new.
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 1, Episodes 25, 26, 27 and 29, and Season 3, Episodes 2, 16 and 18 on Discovery Channel India.
